author: ai
text: China imports 67% of the oil it uses (U.S. Energy Information Administration, 2024) and 84% of the soybeans it uses (FAOSTAT, 2024). Russia was the main supplier of its major arms imports, at 66% (SIPRI, 2021–2025). China produced an estimated 69% of world rare earth mine output and 99% of world primary gallium production (USGS, 2025). It has 1.4 billion people and a GDP of US$19.5 trillion, second of 186 places (World Bank, 2025).
